description: Building Canada Fund - Provincial-Territorial Infrastructure Component - national and regional projects is a dataset listed in Ontario open data catalogue, an open data portal, published or maintained by Infrastructure. The Provincial-Territorial Infrastructure Component - National and Regional Projects (PTIC-NRP) funds nationally and regionally significant projects that are predominantly medium- and large-scale in nature. Eligible project categories include 13 project categories, including critical infrastructure (e.g. drinking water) and infrastructure that promotes economic growth (e.g. broadband). This dataset tracks the approved PTIC-NRP submissions. Coverage: Ontario. The portal files it under the publisher Infrastructure. Its tags are Economy and Business, Gouvernement, Gouvernement et finances, Government, Government and Finance. The portal shows 2021-01-15 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-ontario-portal.
